text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
My apologies. It is all because I forgot 
my own. 
I shall gratefully borrow your track 
jacket.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, think nothing of it. 
I have a spare, so don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It might be a bit large on you since it's 
mine... 
Though it should suffice for some light 
exercise.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. —By the way, the banana cake 
earlier 
was delicious. My thanks.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(Strange. 
Given the height difference between 
Hayahide and me, 
why does this not feel overly large...?)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(Lately, I've eaten Hayahide's sweets, 
dined out with the big eater Brian... 
My intake has undeniably increased...!)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: (Because of that, has my figure...? Ngh!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Phaleno-kun, are you heading to the 
gym as well—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
!? 
What is the matter? Why such a desperate 
look...?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Do not ask... Not right now...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you all right...!? 
Please don't push yourself too hard...!
